why: An icon of the library with no name, written in a namespace the template makes up, `X1:` — a capital and a digit, as Angular's lexer takes a prefix. `ngc` compiles it to the icon component in the HTML namespace (the element `pct-icon`, no namespace instruction): a selector matches the name without its prefix. The walk took off a prefix of small letters alone and the text count read none, so both read no icon here, and the anonymous one passed point 3.
